title: Migrate OpenWeather API credentials to secrets-gradle-plugin
user_visible_behavior: The app builds and fetches weather data cleanly using secrets-gradle-plugin and local.defaults.properties with zero hardcoded API keys in flavors.gradle, and Design System CI watches the real ui/designsystem paths.
verification: Verify clean assemblePreDebug succeeds using local.defaults.properties without hardcoded API_KEY_VALUE in flavors.gradle.
notes: Follow dependency-manager Rule 12 (secrets-gradle-plugin + local.defaults.properties). Also fix outdated trigger paths in .github/workflows/design-system-ci.yml and align JVM module targets.

title: Introduce pure DomainError hierarchy in domain layer
user_visible_behavior: Authentication, network, location, permission, and persistence failures map deterministically to typed DomainError values without leaking Android or infrastructure exceptions across layers.
verification: Pure JVM unit tests verify Throwable-to-DomainError mapping across auth, network, location, and persistence cases.
notes: Replaces legacy CustomError in :data per repository-pattern-governance (safeCall, typed DomainError mappers, Hilt bindings) and CONTEXT.md.

title: Persist OpenWeather condition ID and nocturnal state in Room
user_visible_behavior: Current and favorite cities retain accurate WeatherCondition (SUNNY, RAIN, BASELINE) and nocturnal state (isNight) both online and offline without wiping existing Room data.
verification: Pure JVM unit tests verify OpenWeather ID mapping (800 -> SUNNY, 2xx/3xx/5xx/6xx -> RAIN, fallback -> BASELINE), isNight derivation, and Room schema migration integrity.
notes: Follow room-schema-governance and repository-pattern-governance (SSOT, DTO/Entity/Domain mappers, explicit Room Migration for weatherConditionId + isNight, Hilt DI cleanup).

title: Implement five KISS weather palettes and Roboto Flex 12sp typography
user_visible_behavior: The design system resolves DayBaseline, Sunny, Rain, Night, and ExtremeAlert palettes deterministically, enforces a 12sp minimum font size on Roboto Flex, and bundles WebP assets from docs/ui/resources/.
verification: Pure JVM unit tests verify palette precedence (ExtremeAlert > Night > Sunny > Rain > DayBaseline) and WebP drawables exist in app/src/main/res/drawable/.
notes: DESIGN.md and docs/ui/meteomarto_design_contract.txt are authoritative. Raise labelSmall to 12.sp per design-system-governance and copy docs/ui/resources/*.webp drawables.
